name: Jane Addams
shortBio: American pragmatist philosopher, public sociologist, and co-founder of Hull House who fused empirical urban sociology with participatory democratic ethics and peace philosophy.
centralQuestion: How can democratic solidarity and 'sympathetic knowledge' bridge class, cultural, and gendered divides through shared civic practice?

keyWorks.title: Democracy and Social Ethics
keyWorks.description: Articulates social democracy as an everyday moral commitment grounded in reciprocal civic experience rather than abstract individualism.

keyWorks.title: Twenty Years at Hull-House
keyWorks.description: Classic synthesis of settlement-house urban ethnography, labor reform, and pragmatist social philosophy.
